<thought>The main ion at m/z 193.1103 corresponds to [M+H]⁺, giving a neutral mass of ≈192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈12.5 % M+1) suggests about 11–12 carbons. A formula that fits this mass and carbon count is C₁₂H₁₆O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 192.1150 Da, within typical experimental error).</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
